title: 视觉语言模型可靠性机制研究：注意力、隐藏状态与因果回路
summary: 本文通过统一机制管道VRP，系统研究了VLM中注意力结构与正确性的关系。发现注意力结构几乎无法预测正确性，而隐藏状态几何和稀疏的后期回路能更可靠地指示可靠性。不同融合架构（晚期融合vs早期融合）在可靠性分布上存在显著差异。
summary_en: This paper systematically studies the relationship between attention structure and correctness in VLMs using a unified mechanistic pipeline (VRP). It finds that attention structure is a near-zero predictor of correctness, while hidden-state geometry and sparse late-layer circuits more reliably indicate reliability. Significant architectural splits in reliability distribution are observed between late-fusion and early-fusion models.
